# ADR-3046: A04: Prefer abuse-case reviews for marketplace flow 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Happy-path QA misses adversarial misuse.

## Decision

Product teams SHOULD prefer abuse-case reviews for marketplace flow 10 (A04-10) when incentives invite fraud.

## Consequences

Findings map to detection stories.
